item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.44)] 'NovaCookies' Kit Steals Microsoft 365 Sessions for $320 a Month
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bearish (-0.44)
A new phishing service called "NovaCookies" is enabling attackers to steal authenticated Microsoft 365 sessions for as little as $320 a month, bypassing multifactor authentication (MFA). This adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) service provides a complete toolkit, lowering the barrier for attackers to conduct sophisticated session theft. The shift from credential theft to session theft highlights the need for organizations to implement more robust security measures beyond traditional MFA, focusing on browser security and post-compromise defenses.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.14)] Microsoft warns patch window is collapsing, urges shift to network-level containment
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.14)
Microsoft is cautioning that the time available to patch vulnerabilities is rapidly diminishing, as attackers exploit newly disclosed weaknesses faster than organizations can deploy fixes.
